transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been having really distressing, intrusive memories of a past event that I just can't seem to shake off. I also keep having these flashbacks where it feels like the event is happening all over again. It's getting really hard to deal with on my own.
How long ago did the traumatic event happen, and have these symptoms been going on for more than a month?
The traumatic event happened about two months ago, and these symptoms started pretty much right after it. So yes, I've been dealing with all of this for about two months now.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, Acute Stress Disorder], but Acute Stress Disorder is unlikely because the symptoms have persisted for about two months. Acute Stress Disorder requires symptoms to occur from 3 days to 1 month after trauma, whereas symptoms lasting more than one month are more consistent with Posttraumatic Stress Disorder.
